properties.name: k-Anonymity Group Size Report
properties.description: Returns a k-anonymity report from group counts and a threshold, listing all class sizes, the minimum k, and classes below threshold.

properties.name: k_anonymity_evaluator
properties.description: Compares equivalence-class sizes with a minimum group-size threshold and returns a k-anonymity report. The report lists class sizes, the minimum k achieved, and classes that do not meet the threshold.
